claims.claim: **Often an asymptomatic laboratory finding. Stop any magnesium-containing medicines or IV solutions, and ask about non-prescribed supplements.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Seek specialist advice for any symptomatic child.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Serum level is a poor guide to body stores** (under 1% is extracellular). An asymptomatic high result is sometimes seen after IV magnesium. **Symptoms are unusual below 2 mmol/L.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Causes:** iatrogenic excess from IV infusion or PN (especially with renal impairment), tumour lysis syndrome, and renal impairment.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **After cardiac surgery the target may deliberately be the upper end of normal** to avoid arrhythmia.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Check the sample:** timing against recent magnesium infusions, and whether it was drawn from the same IV access the infusion ran through.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Signs:** loss of deep tendon reflexes · hypotension, ECG changes · **apnoea** · decreased consciousness, somnolence, paralysis.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Stop any magnesium-containing medicines or IV solutions.** ⚠️ **Symptomatic: discuss with PICU** and consider calcium chloride or gluconate, furosemide, or haemodialysis if anuric.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Monitor closely**, clinically and with serum magnesium.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Involve the paediatric team** if symptomatic or significantly abnormal; **consider transfer** if symptomatic or needing monitoring your centre cannot provide.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Hypermagnesaemia' (Last Updated November 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Hypermagnesaemia/, retrieved 2026-09-23
